title: Keep delivered Plans out of the way
statement: As a developer, I can rely on delivered Plans being hidden by default, the way merged Reviews are, so what I see is the work still ahead of us.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An author marks a Plan delivered with an explicit command, which is refused unless every Task is done and every Review linked to the Plan has merged.
A delivered Plan is not listed in the Plans section by default, and a visible filter reveals it.
The CLI's list of Plans leaves out delivered Plans by default, and a flag includes them.
A delivered Plan can still be opened and compared with its Reviews, and it refuses further edits.
